threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new when you assume every street food stall is a pop-up, not just another Saturday market fixture in Dalston.
Heard a couple arguing over whether the night bus was a good choice; she swore it was safer than a cab. Ended with him ordering an Uber while she scowled.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found a whole vintage market in an abandoned subway station. They had records, old cameras, and a chess game in full swing. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see people casually sipping coffee in the middle of a bus stop, completely unfazed by the chaos around them.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows that dodging the BART delays is a daily game; tourists just stare at their phones while the train's stuck in the Tube.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 21 Hayes, practicing his speech for a wedding. Everyone else just acted like it was normal. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but many locals hit up la plaça for a 'bocadillo' and a beer before heading home. It's a hidden gem.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they always order a cappuccino after noon; locals know that's a giveaway to avoid.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'flat' instead of a 'home' and are puzzled why your mates insist on walking past the bus to get to the Overground.
Heard a bloke on the 60 bus last night arguing with his reflection in the window about whether it was worth catching the last train.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found an entire flock of parrots squawking in the backyard of an old tenement. Just another Neukölln surprise.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you get a public transport strike that feels like everyone suddenly remembers their bikes exist, right before a huge party weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local will know to avoid the BART delays and take the 14 Mission to avoid the zoo of confusion at Civic Center. It’s a rite of passage.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a whole band on board. They set up for an impromptu jam session – only in the Mission, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think siestas are a total thing here, but few locals actually do it. We just grab a quick nap if we can between jobs and life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still squint in the sun, like it's an alien planet. Locals have perfected the art of ignoring it.
